environment.description: Celery worker deployed as ECS Fargate task in private subnet (no IGW route in subnet route table). Redis broker is Amazon ElastiCache (cluster mode, auth token enabled) accessible only via com.amazonaws.us-east-1.elasticache VPC endpoint with endpoint policy restricting to the worker task role ARN. The ECS task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem with an ephemeral tmpfs mount at /tmp scoped to the individual task (20MB, noexec,nosuid). The task's awsvpc ENI has a security group allowing egress only to the ElastiCache endpoint prefix list and the ECR/CloudWatch VPC endpoints. No inbound rules exist on the task security group. The VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway attached. Service discovery is via AWS Cloud Map private DNS namespace. The Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with runtime seccomp profile applied (default Docker seccomp). Task IAM role has no S3/SSM/network permissions beyond ElastiCache access and CloudWatch Logs.
